Jwt.Note: ⚠️ PRODUCTION: Replace Key with environment variable JWT_SECRET

Cors.Note: ⚠️ PRODUCTION: Update AllowedOrigins to your production domains only (e.g., https://yourdomain.com)

Email.Note: ⚠️ DEVELOPMENT ONLY - Gmail App Password. PRODUCTION: Use environment variables or SendGrid

GoogleOAuth.Note: ⚠️ PRODUCTION: Replace with production OAuth credentials and use environment variables

FCM.Note: Get ServerKey from Firebase Console > Project Settings > Cloud Messaging > Server key (Legacy)

Firebase.Note: CredentialsPath is relative to API directory. Download service account JSON from Firebase Console > Project Settings > Service Accounts

ImgBB.Note: ImgBB API key for image and document uploads. Max file size: 32MB
